params.comment: MEASURE Seated: floor-to-eye height minus your typing desk height (about the same standing)

params.name: eye_back
params.comment: MEASURE Eyes out from the desktop front edge (toward you, -Y) in your normal posture

params.name: spk_w
params.comment: Speaker: width (X), R-40M spec

params.name: spk_d
params.comment: Speaker: depth front to back (Y), R-40M spec

params.name: spk_h
params.comment: Speaker: height (Z), R-40M spec

params.name: spk_horn
params.comment: MEASURE Speaker: square Tractrix horn faceplate size (1in tweeter, centered on it)

params.name: spk_wf_d
params.comment: MEASURE Speaker: woofer outside diameter incl. trim ring (4in spun-copper cone)

params.name: spk_mount_frac
params.comment: MEASURE Speaker: swivel mount height on the back, as a fraction of height from the bottom

params.name: spk_tw_down
params.comment: MEASURE Speaker: tweeter center below the speaker top

params.name: spk_wf_down
params.comment: MEASURE Speaker: woofer center below the speaker top (default: just under the horn)

params.name: spk_bot
params.comment: Speaker bottom above desktop surface (bracket slides along the upright slot)

params.name: spk_mount_d
params.comment: Upright front face to the speaker back at the swivel (bracket + swivel depth)

params.name: spk_px
params.comment: Speaker swivel X (default: speaker outer face flush with the upright before toe-in)

params.name: spk_py
params.comment: Derived: swivel Y (speaker back face)

params.name: spk_pz
params.comment: Derived: swivel height above desktop surface

params.name: spk_aim
params.expression: atan((spk_px - m1_x) / (spk_py - spk_d/2 + desk_d/2 - desk_y_off + eye_back))
params.comment: Derived: toe-in that points the speakers straight at the Eye marker

params.name: spk_yaw_max
params.comment: Toe-in limit (the left speaker nears the portrait monitor past this)

params.name: spk_yaw
params.comment: Speaker toe-in actually used

params.name: spk_tilt_aim
params.expression: atan((spk_bot + spk_h - spk_tw_down - eye_above_desk) * cos(spk_aim) / (spk_py - spk_d/2 + desk_d/2 - desk_y_off + eye_back))
params.comment: Derived: tilt down that points the tweeter at the Eye (negative = it would need to tilt up)

params.name: spk_tilt
params.comment: Speaker tilt down actually used (the swivel tilts down only)
